checks.detail: The enlarged arena, ordinary movement/dash/pause flow, 32-enemy fixture, and authored draft were freshly exercised, but the external cemetery still terminates in void and camera occlusion hard-hides gameplay-relevant visuals. coverage.baseline.survivor_onboarding_input_guida.aeacca15e82a=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_reward_feedback.f3a12bf95b42=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_enemy_vitality.2e8fe7fe7b3c=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_choice_visual_hierarch.c96a93673ada=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.survivor_arena_spatial_integrit.150a2175f98f=fail; coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_shell_information_presentat.40d0f2cd0a9e=pass;

Ordinary keyboard/gamepad-equivalent movement changed planar position, Space produced one routed anticipation-active-recovery-cooldown dash cycle, and pause/resume context transitions were clean; however, the changed occlusion policy hard-hid bound landmark visuals and one dash-window frame lost nearly the entire gameplay composition.

Automatic attacks, damaged enemies, vitality bars, drops and pickups were visible during ordinary and dense play, but this pass did not bind one complete audible cooldown-to-target-to-hit-to-exactly-once-death-and-drop event chain.

Ordinary enemies approached under movement and the final-profile fixture reached a live roster of 32 with all four role populations, but every role's full spawn, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool-return lifecycle was not bound.

A paused three-choice draft showed authoritative projections, keyboard and gamepad focus transferred across fixed-size cards, one gamepad confirmation applied Wandering Wisps before unpausing, and the runtime immediately owned two orbiting wisps; ordinary death-position reward, threshold, overflow and held-confirm behavior were not fully recaptured.

The compact HUD and authored icon-led draft were readable at the native 1920x1080 viewport with distinct keyboard/gamepad focus, but fullscreen, supported UI-scale, and every authoritative HUD-field parity cell were not completed.

Title-to-gameplay and pause/resume transitions were ordinary-input driven and final-profile reset returned the roster from 32 to zero, but failure, Retry and three complete clean restart baselines were not exercised.

Fresh exact-project source, InputMap, runtime-state, spatial bounds, camera coverage, custom views, ordinary-input transitions, mesh validation, distributed frames and clean final editor/runtime logs bind the active defects, but complete animation/audio and end-to-end release evidence remains incomplete.

The final-profile state equipped three distinct rank-four strategies and the selected Wisps card produced two persistent orbit actors, but every representative upgrade path and three distinct ordinary successful runs were not completed.

The fixture reached wave five, Bellkeeper phase one, 32 ordinary enemies and all weapon families, but five ordinary wave transitions, phase two, exactly-once boss defeat, victory and terminal director stop were not verified.

The scaled cemetery now has approximately 40.08 by 37.68 meters of visual bounds, 1056.18 square meters of declared playable area, 12 spawn lanes and recognizable landmarks, but every derived overview exposes the finite fenced square against immediate black void, unlike the reference's coherent surrounding cemetery.

Dash anticipation/active/recovery visuals and the warm-lantern/cool-moon hierarchy were visible, but hard occlusion destroyed one transition frame and no causal Master/Effects audio capture or complete dense animation-state matrix was bound.

Title, pause and draft use authored Montserrat typography, icons, full-viewport composition and working keyboard/gamepad focus; mouse focus, Settings persistence, death, victory, Result, Retry and Title flows were not all exercised.

The representative fixture reached 32 ordinary enemies, Bellkeeper and all three rank-four weapon families with bounded neighbor work and clean reset, but the renderer was llvmpipe and no native 1920x1080 frame-time distribution or three complete Retry cycles qualified performance.

Ordinary play proved title entry, movement, dash, automatic combat, pause and an applied upgrade, but no complete ordinary seven-to-ten-minute failure/victory matrix or three successful build routes was completed, and the external-void and hard-hide defects remain release-blocking.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
